settings.title: Toys and goodies that bring the giggles

settings.editor: BabyVibes is a shop for moms, by moms. We pick fun, good-value toys and baby essentials, test them with our own little ones and deliver them across South Africa.

settings.editor: Say something and it says it right back in a giggly voice, then wiggles, dances and lights up. Little ones love hearing their own voice played back.

icon_list.text: USB rechargeable, so no batteries to buy

tabs.tab_content: We deliver across South Africa. Orders placed before 12:00 on a weekday are packed the same day, and most arrive within 2 to 4 working days in the main centres. You'll get a tracking number by email.
The delivery fee is shown in your cart and at checkout before you pay. Look out for free-delivery offers.
Pay securely at checkout by card, Instant EFT or the other options shown there. We never see or store your card details.

tabs.tab_title: Are your products safe for my baby?
tabs.tab_content: We choose every product with little ones in mind. Each product page shows the age it's suitable for, so check it before you buy, and always supervise play.

tabs.tab_title: What if something is wrong with my order?
tabs.tab_content: Message us on WhatsApp or email within 7 days of delivery and we'll sort it out with a replacement or a refund. See our FAQ & Delivery page for the details.

settings.editor: Questions before you order? We're a WhatsApp away.
